items.title: ELLA: Efficient Lifelong Learning for Adapters in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: ELLA：面向大模型适配器的高效终身学习
items.summary: ELLA replaces strict orthogonality in continual learning with selective subspace decorrelation, penalizing alignment along high-energy task-specific directions while leaving low-energy residual subspaces free for transfer. It requires no replay or architectural expansion, reports state-of-the-art continual-learning results with up to 9.6% relative accuracy gains and a 35x smaller memory footprint, and improves zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks.

items.title: volcengine/OpenViking
items.title_zh: volcengine/OpenViking：面向 AI 智能体的自演化上下文数据库
items.summary: OpenViking is a Python self-evolving context database for AI agents that unifies agent memory, knowledge RAG and skills.

items.title: Domain Specific Specialization in Low-Resource Settings: The Efficacy of Offline Response-Based Knowledge Distillation in Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 低资源场景下的领域特化：离线响应式知识蒸馏在大模型中的有效性
items.summary: The authors compare three data strategies for offline response-based distillation into Qwen2.5-7B, using Unsloth to cut A100 memory from 40 GB to 16 GB. They find larger unstructured knowledge-injection datasets still hallucinate, while a 500-line context-aware synthetic dataset reaches 96.7% accuracy with robust rejection, supporting the view that data quality and structure matter more than quantity.

items.title: FormationEval, an open multiple-choice benchmark for petroleum geoscience
items.title_zh: FormationEval：面向石油地球科学的开放多项选择基准
items.summary: FormationEval is an open 505-question multiple-choice benchmark covering seven petroleum geoscience domains, built from three authoritative sources with source metadata for traceability. Evaluating 72 models, it reports top accuracy above 97%, with Gemini 3 Pro Preview at 99.8% and GLM-4.7 leading open-weight models at 98.6%, while petrophysics remains the hardest domain.

items.title: From XAI to Stories: A Factorial Study of LLM-Generated Explanation Quality
items.title_zh: 从 XAI 到叙事：大模型生成解释质量的因子研究
items.summary: This factorial study examines how forecasting model choice, XAI method, LLM selection and prompting strategy affect natural-language explanations of model behavior, evaluating 660 explanations with G-Eval and dual judges. It finds that LLM choice dominates, XAI adds only small gains mainly for experts, zero-shot prompting is competitive with self-consistency at seven times lower cost, and chain-of-thought hurts in this setting.

items.title: ACDZero: MCTS Agent for Mastering Automated Cyber Defense
items.title_zh: ACDZero：用于自动化网络防御的 MCTS 智能体
items.summary: ACDZero frames automated cyber defense in the CAGE Challenge 4 as a partially observable Markov decision problem and uses Monte Carlo tree search guided by graph-neural-network embeddings of network observations and learned priors over graph-edit actions. In CC4 scenarios with varied network structures and adversary behavior, it improves defense reward and robustness over state-of-the-art reinforcement-learning baselines.

items.title: Scalable Construction of a Lung Cancer Knowledge Base: Profiling Semantic Reasoning in LLMs
items.title_zh: 可扩展肺癌知识库构建：刻画大模型的语义推理能力
items.summary: The study builds a lung cancer knowledge base with open information extraction, combining MeSH concepts, CC0-licensed PubMed literature, subject-relation-object triplets and NER enrichment, then fine-tunes T5 models. It reports improved ROUGE and BERTScore results.

items.title: GEM-Style Constraints for PEFT with Dual Gradient Projection in LoRA
items.title_zh: 面向 LoRA 参数高效微调的 GEM 约束与双梯度投影
items.summary: I-GEM revisits Gradient Episodic Memory inside the LoRA subspace, using a fixed-budget, GPU-resident dual projected-gradient approximation to GEM's quadratic projection while constraining non-interference only in adapter parameters. On a three-task AG News split with GPT-2 and LoRA, it matches GEM's average accuracy within about 0.04 points and cuts projection time by roughly 1,000x.

items.title: Orchestral AI: A Framework for Agent Orchestration
items.summary: Orchestral is a lightweight Python framework that gives developers a single type-safe interface for LLM agents across major providers, deriving tool schemas from Python type hints and using a synchronous streaming execution model. It supports sandboxing, sub-agents, memory and MCP.
